title: arashouse env --lease <lease_id> --json
description: The environment `arashouse run` gives its command, as one object, for a caller that starts its own processes (a Windows tool, or the WSL launcher's `run`). Like `get --json` it carries the lease's password; it is printed only with --json.

ARAS_URL.description: The slot's URL as this process reaches it (http://localhost/ah-23-01 on Windows).

ARAS_PKG_ENGINE.description: The import-export-libs-js engine for this server.
